info.title: chatform API
info.description: Agentic chatbot forms platform. /p/* = public respondent surface, /v1/* = developer API (API key), /api/* = dashboard (session auth).

secretKey.description: A server-side secret key. Never send one from a browser — a request carrying an Origin header is refused for this reason.

publishableKey.description: A browser-safe key, restricted to the origins listed on it.

apiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same keys, in the header most integrators reach for first.

respondentToken.name: x-respondent-token
respondentToken.description: Scoped to one chat session, and it expires. This is what a browser should hold.

get.description: Read this before `POST /v1/templates/{slug}/use` if you want to see or adapt the questions rather than take them as they are.

post.summary: Create a draft form from a template
post.description: Creates a draft, exactly as `POST /v1/forms` does — publish it when you are ready. Omit `workspace` to use the organization's first.

402.description: A plan limit refuses another form

get.summary: Every published version of a form, newest first
get.description: Each version carries the number of completed responses recorded against it — a version nobody answered can be replaced freely; one with responses behind it is the schema those answers were recorded against.

get.summary: One published version, optionally diffed against another
get.description: Pass `compare` with another version number to get the list of changes between them.

200.description: The published document, plus a diff when `compare` is given

post.summary: Restore a published version into the working document
post.description: Writes the draft, not the live form — respondents see nothing change until you publish. Returns the restored document and what it changed.

200.description: The draft now matches that version

post.summary: Generate a form document from a natural-language prompt
post.description: Returns a document and its lint issues **without saving anything** — pass the result to `POST /v1/forms` to keep it. Consumes one `ai_generations` unit and the tokens it costs, charged only when a usable document comes back. If you are already driving this from a model of your own, writing the document yourself and posting it to `/v1/forms` costs you nothing here.

200.description: The generated document, its lint issues, and the tokens spent

402.description: Out of generations for this billing period

403.description: The key lacks the ai:generate scope

503.description: AI is not configured on this deployment

post.summary: Ask a model to change an existing form: add, edit or remove questions and rewire the flow
post.description: Returns the proposed document **without saving it** — send it to `PUT /v1/forms/{id}/doc` to keep it. An edit may add no questions at all: most requests about a working form change the routing rather than the wording. Pass `history` (oldest first) when this is a follow-up, or the model cannot resolve 'also', 'it' or 'instead'.

200.description: The proposed document and what changed

get.summary: A form's non-webhook integrations
get.description: Currently just the spreadsheet feed, if one exists. An empty array means no feed has been created.

put.summary: Create, update or rotate the spreadsheet feed
put.description: Idempotent by nature — one feed per form — which is why this is a PUT. The returned `feedUrl` is a live CSV a spreadsheet can re-read on a schedule; it is unauthenticated, so the URL is the whole credential. Send `rotate: true` to invalidate the previous one.

402.description: Including unfinished responses needs a plan that allows it

delete.description: The URL stops working immediately. Any spreadsheet reading it will start failing to refresh.

get.summary: Recent delivery attempts, for working out why an endpoint is quiet

post.summary: Replay one delivery
Start an export of a form's responses
post.description: Returns immediately with a queued export. Poll `GET /v1/exports/{id}` until `status` is `ready`, then follow `download_url`.

402.description: Exporting unfinished responses needs a plan that includes them

get.summary: Check an export and get its download link
get.description: Poll until `status` is `ready`, then follow `download_url`. A `failed` export carries the reason in `error`. The link is re-minted on every read, so read again rather than storing one.

get.summary: List recent exports
get.description: Newest first, optionally narrowed to one form. Exports are deleted 24 hours after they are requested, so this is a short window rather than a history.

get.summary: A respondent's uploaded file, with a short-lived download link
get.description: File-upload answers carry a `fileId`. This resolves one to its metadata and a signed URL that needs no API key — safe to hand to a browser, and expired within minutes.

post.summary: Register an upload — returns a fileId to PUT against

put.summary: Upload the bytes for a registered intent
put.description: PUT the raw file body — not multipart, not base64 — to the `uploadUrl` returned by the intent step. The declared size must match within 1KB, and the object is not visible to the form until `confirm`.

post.summary: Confirm an upload — flips pending → confirmed and notifies the session

get.summary: Follow a signed download link
get.description: You never build this URL yourself — `GET /v1/exports/{id}` and `GET /v1/files/{id}` return it complete. It carries no API key, expires within minutes, and answers 404 for anything it cannot serve, including a link that has expired.
